profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: I love full stack web development and exploring new technologies which help make the web a great experience for everyone. My dream job would be one where I can not only create great experiences online but also make a difference in the world working with people who really believe in what they do and treat their work as though it is an art. I am always open to exciting opportunities near me.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Built custom subscription management portal in React with Express server
- Maintained APIs for front end and cross team use.
- Mentor other developers on clean code and SOLID
- Update Shopify themes to assist marketing campaigns.

positions.title: Software Engineer Technical Lead
positions.description:
- Develop and maintain multiple applications related to marketing and purchasing of SaaS software products.
- Build API’s and integrations with Nodejs and Typescript
- Build frontend experience with React and Typescript
- Build partnership tools to quickly make deals without developer intervention
- Run team knowledge sharing and training sessions

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Maintain and develop customer facing web applications
- Create sharepoint customizations using react
- Increase productivity with agile methodologies
- Maintain legacy internal tools
- Maintained and developed azure functions and web applications

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Led trainings on SOLID principles and design patterns
- Held hybrid position of Scrum master for Team of 5 developers
- Maintain and add features to a web application built with AngularJs, Typescript, and C# MVC/Webforms.
- Built new customer facing reporting system using reusable components for quick addition of new reports
- Managed conversion from Javascript to Typescript
- Migrated from mercurial to Git.
- Migrated from webforms to MVC
- Migrated to use Sass for CSS
- Switched the application layout to customized Bootstrap.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Set up a git version control system
- Set up a task management system (JIRA) to organize project management.
- Implemented checkout with amazon payments for websites.
- Wrote shell scripts to implement auto deployment of website code.
- Implemented foundation and bootstrap frameworks for responsive website designs.
- Wrote financial tracking tool Php/Mysql for P&L

positions.title: Technical SEO Specialist
positions.description:
- Created a tool in PHP/MySQL to track search engine rankings for branded keywords.
- Modified Genesis framework child themes in wordpress to meet website goals.
- Created wordpress plugins to add necessary functionality to each website.
- Update and organize content for each website using HTML/CSS

positions.title: Webmaster
positions.description:
- Web programming
- Make frequent updates
- Maintain websites content
- Create layouts of new websites
- Dynamically generate comparison shopping feeds
- Product image editing, Adobe Photoshop
- Online search engine marketing
- SEO
